product_one_liner.value: Bitly helps businesses and marketers create, share, and track branded short links and QR Codes.
product_one_liner.notes: Bitly describes creating branded links and QR Codes and tracking clicks and scans; its pricing page identifies brands and businesses as its intended audience.

pricing_page.notes: Bitly has a public pricing page describing pricing for businesses and plan offerings.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Bitly’s customer stories include named case studies for Hacking HR and ASUG. | named_customers.0: The customer stories page names Hacking HR in a customer case study. | named_customers.1: The customer stories page names ASUG in a customer case study.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile reports 338 employees, which falls in the 201–500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Bitly’s contact page identifies its US headquarters in New York, NY. | hq_country: Bitly’s contact page labels the New York office as its US Headquarters and gives a New York, NY address.

founded_year.notes: Bitly’s press page explicitly says the company was founded in 2008.

eng_blog.notes: The Bitly Engineering Blog includes multiple technical posts about product infrastructure: NSQ’s distributed message processing architecture and Bitly’s stream-based link-data infrastructure.

public_docs.notes: Bitly provides a public developer portal with API documentation and an API reference.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Bitly’s careers job board states that there are no current openings.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Bitly publicly states it is SOC 2 compliant and GDPR compliant; those are the listed claims among the requested certification categories. | compliance_certs.0: Bitly’s Trust Center states it is SOC 2 compliant. | compliance_certs.1: Bitly’s Trust Center states it is GDPR compliant.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding sources classify the July 2017 investment as growth equity and Series D, respectively. | funding_date: The funding history dates the growth investment to July 2017. | funding_amount_usd: The indexed funding history identifies a July 2017 growth investment and reports $63.0M as the latest funding amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified funding round was in July 2017, well before the 18-month window preceding November 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Bitly’s careers job board states that there are no current openings.

launched_6mo.notes: The Bitly Support release history labels a September 2026 entry as AI traffic for individual links and describes the new analytics card, inside the six-month period.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Bitly announced Matt Young’s appointment as Chief Technology Officer on March 19, 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Bitly’s integration pages explicitly identify its Salesforce integration and describe link and engagement workflows in Salesforce. | crm_stack_signal.0: Bitly’s integration directory and integration description name Salesforce.
